intro: Live events come straight from Ninja Kiwi's public Open Data API each time you open this tab, so they're always current. The notes below explain how each event works.

formats.name: Boss Bloon Event
formats.schedule: Weekly, usually Saturday 02:00 to Thursday 03:00 UTC. Bosses rotate: Bloonarius, Lych, Vortex, Dreadbloon, Phayze, Blastapopoulos, Diamondback.
rules: A modified Boss Challenge: beat all five boss tiers before round 140 starts (tiers arrive on rounds 40, 60, 80, 100 and 120).
Usually Medium with $650, 200 lives (100 in Elite) and up to 4 Paragons; some weeks restrict towers, heroes or modes.
Elite opens in single player after you beat tier 5 Normal. Ranked mode scores by fastest time, least cash or least tiers.
tips: Paragons are the main boss damage: each 20 degrees adds 25% boss damage, and Elite bosses take double from them.
Check the boss page here for its health per tier and which Paragons suit it.
Plan income early (Benjamin, Geraldo or farms) so you can afford Paragons by the later tiers.

formats.name: Race Event
formats.schedule: Weekly, usually Friday 07:00 to Tuesday 03:00 UTC. The first attempt is free; later attempts cost Monkey Money for 3 hours unless you use a Race Pass.
rules: Beat a set number of rounds as fast as possible; you may send future rounds early.
Each race has its own map, modifiers and tower or hero limits.
Pausing too often costs time (more than once every 25 seconds).
tips: High-pierce, grouped damage matters most: Bloons arrive in huge clumps.
Leaking a few lives early is normal for a top time.
Strong cheap starters include a base Mortar; mid-game picks include Wall of Fire, Druid of the Jungle, Glaive Ricochet, Juggernaut, Cannon Ship and Cluster Bombs.
When allowed, Rosalia (Scatter Missile) and Gwendolin (Cocktail of Fire) are strong starting heroes.
Plan the run before starting; very high Monkey Knowledge helps for leaderboard times.

formats.name: Odyssey
formats.schedule: Weekly. Easy has 3 islands, Medium 4, Hard 5.
rules: Pick a crew (towers, Powers and one hero) before you start; only those can be used, up to the copies you chose.
All islands share one pool of lives, and finishing an island with fewer lives lowers your maximum for the rest.
In Extreme mode, any tower you place on an island can't be used on later islands (selling it frees it for that island only).
tips: Build the crew around the hardest island first.
Bring Camo, Lead and MOAB answers that fit the number of seats.
Protect lives early: lost lives can only be regained within the same island.

formats.name: Contested Territory
formats.schedule: Every other week, Tuesday 22:00 UTC for 7 days, alternating with Boss Rush.
rules: Six teams fight over a hexagonal board; each tile has a challenge and a scoring type (race, least cash, least tiers, boss…).
You can only attack tiles next to ones your team owns. Players get 4 tickets a day; a ticket is spent only when you capture.
Tiles give points for 24 hours, then stop, and turn neutral after 72 hours. Scores on a tile get easier to beat starting 5 hours after capture.
tips: Banner tiles give the most points; Relic tiles give your team useful bonuses on every tile.
Coordinate with your team about who takes which tile type.
Up to four Relics from tiles can be used at a time, plus shop Relics bought with team trophies.
